author: Sanne de Vries
text: Reminder: NL holiday allowance is 8% and pays out in May. Please don't mix it up with Belgian double holiday pay, different concept entirely.

author: Bram Koster
text: 30% ruling max duration is 5 years for new grants, keep an eye on the decision dates.

author: Sanne de Vries
text: Holiday allowance accrual runs June to May, remember that for leavers mid-year.
